display.title: Episode 462: The Lost Letter, Chapter 2 (Rosh Chodesh Shevat)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Rosh Chodesh Shevat Uncle Yossi speaks about the third Beis HaMikdash, a young Tzivos Hashem member talks about fighting the yetzer hara, and the lost letter is finally delivered.
display.summary_long: Broadcast as the month of Shevat began. Uncle Yossi recalls the prayer of Shabbos Mevarchim for a month of joy and peace, and explains that the third Beis HaMikdash will be built by Hashem Himself and will therefore stand forever. After the Hakochainik march, a returning young guest, a proud member of Tzivos Hashem, tells how he fights the yetzer hara with the secret weapon of Torah and mitzvos, then leads the Shema; everyone gives tzedakah. Story time concludes 'The Lost Letter'. Ten years after the Baal Shem Tov's passing, the impoverished Reb Leibel sells his great cedar closet and finds the forgotten sealed letter underneath. He travels to the wealthy Reb Shalom, who recognizes his Rebbe's seal. The letter, dated that very day, asks Reb Shalom to set Reb Leibel back on his feet. Uncle Yossi draws the lesson about the power of a tzaddik's brachah and invites listeners to send in essays and stories for the mailbox.
display.lesson: Never think you do not need a brachah; a blessing, especially from a tzaddik, opens a channel for Hashem's goodness.
